subject.title: feat(cron): per-job dynamic cadence (pacing + clamped next_check)

question: Should stage-one per-job pacing be sponsored as a public cron and gateway contract now, after restricting it to recurring schedules and proving the runtime path?
rationale: The branch introduces new persisted, CLI, tool, and gateway protocol surfaces as one stage of an open broader product proposal; correctness repair alone cannot establish that this is the intended permanent product contract.

options.title: Sponsor bounded stage one
options.body: Keep the feature additive, require recurring-only validation and live runtime proof, and merge it as the scoped first stage of the linked cron direction.

options.title: Pause for the umbrella design
options.body: Defer this public contract until the broader cron/heartbeat design has an explicit maintainer-approved rollout plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor bounded stage one
recommendation.body: Keep the feature additive, require recurring-only validation and live runtime proof, and merge it as the scoped first stage of the linked cron direction.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the staged cron proposal and can clarify the intended contract while a repository decision owner confirms sponsorship.
